dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: hazard report during shift handover on B-8202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on B-8202 and PSV-8202 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. B-8202 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during shift handover while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 19 June 2014 a hazard report was recorded on B-8202 and PSV-8202 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during shift handover; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
